title: The Sculpt Era: Glutes, Back & Core
desc:
Step into your strength with The Sculpt Era: an 8 week, 4 day gym program for women who want to develop their glutes, strengthen their back, and build better hip and core control.

Designed with beginner lifters in mind, this program pairs two lower body sessions with two back focused upper body sessions. Barbell hip thrusts, barbell squats, Romanian deadlifts, rows, and pulldowns form the foundation, supported by targeted glute, hip, and core exercises. Smaller amounts of chest, shoulder, and arm work keep the routine balanced without taking attention away from your priorities.

Each workout includes prescribed sets, repetition ranges, and recommended RPE targets to guide how hard your working sets should feel. Repeat the key movements, practice your technique, and gradually increase repetitions or weight as your performance allows. A lighter fifth week reduces the workload before the final three weeks.

You will need access to a full gym and time for four sessions each week, with up to 75–90 minutes available per session.

Train with purpose, track your progress, and make this your strong era.
